title: workaholic.slack-binding/v1
description: One repository-declared Slack binding. Written as a fenced `workaholic-slack-binding` block inside the repository's own instruction file (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or a nested one), read only through transport/scripts/read-declared-binding.sh.

workspace.description: Slack workspace or team name. Required: a channel name alone is never enough.

channel_id.description: Slack channel ID (C…). The stable coordinate; a name can be renamed.

mount.description: Preferred QFS mount, e.g. /slack/qmu. Absent means: describe every connection.

account.description: QFS account or profile label. An operator-facing label, never proof of who speaks.

sender_id.description: Slack user/bot ID expected to speak (U…/B…). The only verified sender fact.

operations.description: Operations this binding must be able to perform. A route offering fewer is not this binding.

fallback.description: Ordered transports permitted after a TYPED preferred-route failure. An empty list forbids every fallback.
